summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but unverified: I did not run any tests or repository code, per the instructions. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (single combined pattern, json. prefix); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* styles; rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json before inspect; docs/source/console.rst gets a "Printing JSON" section, a new reference/json.rst page is added to reference.rst, and CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added entry; tests/test_json.py is new. Choices made: overflow is set to Python None (the spec's "none" is not a valid overflow value); the CLI imports Console inside its main guard; the expected ANSI output in the styled test was derived by hand from the SGR rules, not from a run. Nothing is committed. Next step: run pytest on tests/test_json.py, test_highlighter.py and test_console.py.
